content: We evaluate the corpus using Named Entity Recognition (NER), i. e., the task of finding mentions of concepts of interest in unstructured text. We focus on detecting cases, conditions, factors, findings and modifiers in case reports (cf. Section SECREF6). We approach this as a sequence labeling problem. Four systems were developed to offer comparable robust baselines.
